valid_fixes: Restore FrontHandlerFunction Environment Variable FRIEND_TABLE to !Ref FriendTable
invalid_patches: Hardcoding the DynamoDB table name as a string
Changing the Lambda code to read the table name from SSM Parameter Store
optimal_diagnostic_path: Send a friend request; observe no DynamoDB record written; invoke Lambda directly; observe boto3 DynamoDB client error using a queue URL as table name; check FrontHandlerFunction environment variables; observe FRIEND_TABLE resolves to queue URL instead of table name.
observability_check: functional_test assertion 'request_record_created' fails; FrontHandlerFunction CloudWatch logs show ResourceNotFoundException from DynamoDB
observable_symptom: All friend actions (Request, Accept, Reject, Unfriend) silently fail. No records are written to or removed from the database. The front-handler Lambda raises an exception on every message, causing the SQS batch to fail and messages to be requeued indefinitely.
root_cause: FrontHandlerFunction FRIEND_TABLE environment variable references !Ref FrontQueue, which resolves to the SQS queue URL. boto3 DynamoDB Table() is initialized with a queue URL instead of a table name, causing every DynamoDB call to fail with ResourceNotFoundException.
